learning_outcomes.text: Collect the basic principles and laws of the chosen part of the classical physics
Describe, clarify and interpret the particular natural phenomena
Apply the simple mathematical methods for describing of the physical phenomena
Illustrate obtained knowledge in the frame of the easy applications

syllabus_topics: Kinematics and dynamics of mass point
Newton's second law in angular form
The second Newton's law for rotational movements
Rotational inertia and energy of rotational movement
Simple harmonic and damped harmonic motions
Waves propagation in homogeneous media and effects at the interface
bibliography: Halliday D., Resnick R., Walker J.: Fundamentals of Physics, John Wiley and Sons, Inc. 1997
Feynman R.P., Leighton R.B., Sands M.: The Feynman lectures on physics, Vol. 1.,Addison-Wesley 1966
Murla M., Pekárek S.: Physics I, ČVUT 1992
Murla M., Pekárek S.: Physics I - seminars, ČVUT 1995
institution: Vysoka Skola Banska- Technicka Univerzita Ostrava
degree: ECTS course offer for Erasmus+ students - Faculty of Mechanical Engineering (first cycle courses)
